findings.message: Font families used without @font-face declaration: sfmono-regular, newsreader, segoe print. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files. For an OS-bundled system font (e.g. Hiragino Sans, Microsoft YaHei) that has no downloadable file, use src: local('Exact Font Name') instead. The declaration alone satisfies this check without needing a font file.

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#s6-bubble, #s6-suggest, #s6-newbox" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.
